verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Pinecone serves an llms.txt at docs.pinecone.io (HTTP 200) describing its official documentation. First-party docs add agent-oriented guidance for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentic tools, plus an MCP server that lets agents search Pinecone documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence of the llms.txt's depth or completeness, and no llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.pinecone.io/llms.txt # Pinecone Docs
Use Pinecone with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and other agentic tools
Using the MCP server, agents can search Pinecone documentation, manage indexes, upsert data, and query indexes for relevant information.
